# The starters — standing reference

*Generated by `pnpm reference` from `data/world/starters.json` — do not edit by hand. The five starting decks (one per colour — the five roads), as the player receives them at a new game: the decklist (lands first, then by mana value), its stats (cards / lands / average mana value of the nonland cards), the basic land it refills with after a lost ante, and the difficulty adjustments applied at new-game. Deck size is the player's to change afterwards (the editor); a 30-card starter is the world's baseline (`deckLegal`). The starter round-robin (the five against each other under the heuristic) is a measurement, not data — it lives in the handoff of the session that ran it (`pnpm mage-sweep --part 4`).*

## New-game constants

| Constant | Value |
|---|---|
| Starting world life | 10 (easy 10 / hard 10) |
| Starting gold | 20 (easy 20 / hard 20) |
| Starter spares (extra copies handed to the collection) | 10 (easy 14 / hard 6) |
| Ante per duel | 1 (easy 1 / hard 2) |
